verdict.rationale: The product is a set of skills that run inside coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot), so you operate it by talking to the agent. The grilling skill interviews the user conversationally, and skill descriptions such as "Use when the user wants to stress-test their thinking" let the agent pick a skill from plain-language intent; a meta-skill also recommends which skill fits the situation. Missing for 10: the documented primary invocation is slash commands rather than free-form requests, installation and updates go through CLI commands (`npx skills update`, `claude plugins install`), and no hands-on or independent report confirms natural-language triggering works reliably.
